newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall on Bulgaria 6-, 9-mth floater T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bulgaria 6-, 9-mth floater T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell on Bulgaria's Finance Ministry floating interest T-bills with maturities of six and nine months auctioned on Monday as a cut in the central bank main interest rate took effect, central bank figures showed.
Average yields to maturity on the two issues were 24.26 and 37.72 percent, down from 28.59 and 44.61 percent at the respective auctions a week earlier.
The average accepted prices for the two issues auctioned on Monday were 97.76 and 96.01 percent of par compared to 97.73 and 95.78 percent for the two respective maturities auctioned on May 19.
Interest on the issues is due at maturity. It is set equal to the central bank main interest rate for each of the issues and is adjusted every time the rate changes.
A cut in the central bank main interest rate to 43.08 percent annually from previous 51.48 percent became effective on Monday.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 8,000 million levs 2,000 bln levs
Bids received 8,270 million levs 1,800 million levs
Average price of bids 97.76 pct 96.01 pct
Bids approved 8,000 million levs 1,800 million levs
Average yield to maturity 24.26 pct 37.72 pct
